messages:
linda_sales: Quick heads-up 10x Health wants completed SIG/CAIQ excerpts + a one-line DSAR + deletion evidence row for their vendor spreadsheet. Need by Fri EOD CET. They specifically called out embeddings, prompt logs, and 'training use' language.

omar_sec: Got it. I'll pull CAIQ IDs that map to data retention, key mgmt, and access controls. Clarify: do they want a technical artifact (S3 delete-marker/db tombstone) or legal attestation?

tess_privacy: For POC customers usually accept purge job logs + delete markers + a signed attestation. We must include controller/processor statement and subprocessors list. I'll draft a concise DSAR runbook: 1) verify requester, 2) scope data, 3) export+redact, 4) purge, 5) produce evidence + attestation.

ryan_infra: Region/infra notes: we can pin POC to eu-central-1 and enforce VPC endpoints. Default retention for this trial can be shortened: embeddings=30d, logs=14d, metrics=90d. Artifacts we can produce: sanitized s3_delete_marker.txt, purge_job_YYYYMMDD.log, db_tombstone_sample.json.

linda_sales: They also want explicit DPA language: "no training use without opt-in" and a short clause they can paste. Can someone paste a DPA-friendly single sentence?

tess_privacy: Paste this: "Redwood will not use POC customer telemetry, prompts, or embeddings for model training or improvement without explicit written opt-in from the customer; retention and deletion follow the POC onboarding configuration and DSAR runbook."

omar_sec: CSV-style mapping (one row per telemetry) below for procurement paste:
```
telemetry,storage,region,encryption,access,retention_days,deletion_evidence,caiq_ref
embeddings,encrypted-store,eu-central-1,KMS,restricted-acl,30,db-tombstone+purge-log,DP-3
prompts(debug),ephemeral-blob,eu-central-1,KMS,limited,7,blob-delete-marker+audit,AP-4
request_logs,s3-project-logs,eu-central-1,KMS,rbac+audit,14,s3-delete-marker+job-log,SC-8
metrics,tsdb,eu-central-1,disk-enc,svc-roles,90,retention-policy-log,CM-2
```

ryan_infra: I'll attach sanitized examples to the calendar invite and confirm region lock. We can also provide KMS rotate records on request as extra proof.

legal-bot: ACTION: attach poc_trial_dpa_v1 and subprocessors_declaration when sending. Template link: https://redwood.example.com/legal/poc_trial_dpa_v1

linda_sales: Thanks all. I'll send the one-pager + invite a 30-min walkthrough (Thu 09:30 CET suggested). Please flag if you need more time. :thumbsup:
